# zlaqge

> Scales a general rectangular matrix, using row and column scaling factors computed by sgeequ.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import zlaqge from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/base/zlaqge';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
zlaqge(
    order,
    M, N,
    A, LDA,
    r, strideR,
    c, strideC,
    rowcnd, colcnd, amax,
    equed
) → Complex128Array
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order` | `Layout` | Storage layout ('row-major' or 'column-major') |
| `M` | `NonNegativeInteger` | The number of rows of the matrix A. |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | The number of columns of the matrix A. |
| `A` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>max(M, 1) × N</sub> | **in/out** · On entry, the M by N matrix A. On exit, the equilibrated matrix. |
| ↳ `LDA` | `PositiveInteger` | Leading dimension of `A` |
| `r` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length M</sub> | The row scale factors for A. |
| ↳ `strideR` | `integer` | Stride length for `r` |
| `c` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | The column scale factors for A. |
| ↳ `strideC` | `integer` | Stride length for `c` |
| `rowcnd` | `number` | Ratio of the smallest R(i) to the largest R(i). |
| `colcnd` | `number` | Ratio of the smallest C(i) to the largest C(i). |
| `amax` | `number` | Absolute value of largest matrix entry. |
| `equed` | `Array.<string>` | **out** · Specifies the form of equilibration that was done. `'none'`: No equilibration `'row'`: Row equilibration, i.e., A has been premultiplied by diag(R). `'column'`: Column equilibration, i.e., A has been postmultiplied by diag(C). `'both'`: Both row and column equilibration, i.e., A has been replaced by diag(R) \* A \* diag(C). |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `M`: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.
- `N`: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `A`: On entry, the M by N matrix A. On exit, the equilibrated matrix. See `EQUED` for the form of the equilibrated matrix.
- `r`: The row scale factors for A.
- `c`: The column scale factors for A.
- `rowcnd`: Ratio of the smallest `R(i)` to the largest `R(i)`.
- `colcnd`: Ratio of the smallest `C(i)` to the largest `C(i)`.
- `amax`: Absolute value of largest matrix entry.
- `equed`: Specifies the form of equilibration that was done.

  -   `= 'N'`: No equilibration
  -   `= 'R'`: Row equilibration, i.e., A has been premultiplied by diag(R).
  -   `= 'C'`: Column equilibration, i.e., A has been postmultiplied by diag(C).
  -   `= 'B'`: Both row and column equilibration, i.e., A has been replaced by $\operatorname{diag}(R) \, A \, \operatorname{diag}(C)$.

</details>

**Returns** `Complex128Array`: `A`

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid order

### Strided (ndarray) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
zlaqge.ndarray(
    M, N,
    A, strideA1, strideA2, offsetA,
    r, strideR, offsetR,
    c, strideC, offsetC,
    rowcnd, colcnd, amax,
    equed
) → Complex128Array
```

Equilibrates a complex general M-by-N matrix A using the row and column.
scaling factors in the vectors R and C.

Returns 'none' (no equilibration), 'row' (row only), 'column' (column only),
or 'both' (both row and column).

Matrix shapes are logical (rows × columns). The reference's leading dimension (`LDA`, …) is replaced by the two strides and the offset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `M` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of rows of A |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of columns of A |
| `A` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>max(M, 1) × N</sub> | **in/out** · Input/output M-by-N complex matrix |
| ↳ `strideA1` | `integer` | Stride of the first dimension of A (complex elements) |
| ↳ `strideA2` | `integer` | Stride of the second dimension of A (complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetA` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Index offset for A (complex elements) |
| `r` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length M</sub> | Row scale factors, length M |
| ↳ `strideR` | `integer` | Stride for r |
| ↳ `offsetR` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Index offset for r |
| `c` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | Column scale factors, length N |
| ↳ `strideC` | `integer` | Stride for c |
| ↳ `offsetC` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Index offset for c |
| `rowcnd` | `number` | Ratio of smallest to largest R(i) |
| `colcnd` | `number` | Ratio of smallest to largest C(i) |
| `amax` | `number` | Absolute value of largest matrix entry |
| `equed` | `Array.<string>` | **out** · Specifies the form of equilibration that was done. `'none'`: No equilibration `'row'`: Row equilibration, i.e., A has been premultiplied by diag(R). `'column'`: Column equilibration, i.e., A has been postmultiplied by diag(C). `'both'`: Both row and column equilibration, i.e., A has been replaced by diag(R) \* A \* diag(C). |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `M`: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.
- `N`: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `A`: On entry, the M by N matrix A. On exit, the equilibrated matrix. See `EQUED` for the form of the equilibrated matrix.
- `r`: The row scale factors for A.
- `c`: The column scale factors for A.
- `rowcnd`: Ratio of the smallest `R(i)` to the largest `R(i)`.
- `colcnd`: Ratio of the smallest `C(i)` to the largest `C(i)`.
- `amax`: Absolute value of largest matrix entry.
- `equed`: Specifies the form of equilibration that was done.

  -   `= 'N'`: No equilibration
  -   `= 'R'`: Row equilibration, i.e., A has been premultiplied by diag(R).
  -   `= 'C'`: Column equilibration, i.e., A has been postmultiplied by diag(C).
  -   `= 'B'`: Both row and column equilibration, i.e., A has been replaced by $\operatorname{diag}(R) \, A \, \operatorname{diag}(C)$.

</details>

**Returns** `Complex128Array`: `A`

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   `zlaqge()` corresponds to the reference LAPACK routine [`ZLAQGE`](https://github.com/Reference-LAPACK/lapack/blob/v3.12.0/SRC/zlaqge.f).

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import Complex128Array from '@stdlib/array/complex128/lib/index.js';
import discreteUniform from '@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform/lib/index.js';
import zlaqge from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/base/zlaqge';

/** @type {{ dtype: 'float64' }} */
const opts = {
	'dtype': 'float64'
};
const N = 3;
const A = new Complex128Array( discreteUniform( 2 * N * N, -10, 10, opts ) );
const r = discreteUniform( N, -10, 10, opts );
const c = discreteUniform( N, -10, 10, opts );

// Using the standard interface:
const equed = [ '' ];
let out = zlaqge( 'column-major', N, N, A, N, r, 1, c, 1, 1, 1, 1, equed );
console.log( out, equed[ 0 ] );

// Using the ndarray interface:
out = zlaqge.ndarray( N, N, A, N, 1, 0, r, 1, 0, c, 1, 0, 1, 1, 1, equed );
console.log( out, equed[ 0 ] );
```

</section>
